newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $104/dressed, up $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $104/dressed, up $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live and dressed basis steady to $0.50 per cwt higher, USDA said. Buyer inquiry very good, and several scheduling some of today's purchases for Wednesday's kill. Producers becoming active traders at top side of following quotes.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs - live basis mostly 64.00 in 4% area; dressed basis 103.00-104.00. Those at 103.00 on early rounds. ( weighted average 103.72 ).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs - live basis mostly 64.00 in 4% areas; dressed basis 103.00-104.00. Those at 103.00 on early rounds. ( weighted average 103.70 ).
For week - 29,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 17,200 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 7,800
